cohort: The study surveyed 720 women who had undergone cesarean delivery.
finding: The majority of women filled an opioid prescription after cesarean delivery but consumed only half of the dispensed tablets, and the quantity dispensed did not correlate with patient satisfaction, pain control, or refill needs.
mod_finding: All findings regarding opioid prescribing patterns and patient outcomes are specifically related to post-cesarean delivery, a particular mode of birth.
